echo: How do I get to the abbey in town?

lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
lines.text: There's no abbey in these parts, mo chara, so ye'd best turn your steps elsewhere. What business had ye hoping to find it?

lines.speaker: A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron
lines.text: *A broad-shouldered man in a leather apron shrugs and wipes soot from his brow with a rag.*
